component.name: Proton VPN GUI
component.summary: Community Qt interface for the Proton VPN CLI

description.p: A lightweight Qt-based graphical interface for the Proton VPN command-line tool. Supports connecting to servers by country or city, account management, favorites, connection history, and VPN settings.
The Flatpak ships a bundled copy of the Proton VPN CLI, so no separate host installation is needed. VPN connections are created on the host NetworkManager daemon over the system D-Bus.
Bundled the Proton VPN CLI into the Flatpak.

ul.li: The Flatpak now ships its own copy of the protonvpn CLI plus its Python dependencies, so it no longer depends on a CLI installed on the host system.
VPN connections are created directly on the host NetworkManager daemon over the shared D-Bus, so no extra host software is required.
Command execution is simplified: all bundled CLI interactions run in-sandbox (no more flatpak-spawn delegation).

description.p: Larger default window and a sidebar that scales with it.

ul.li: The app now opens at 1280x800 instead of 980x660, so long country names are no longer cut off.
The expanded server list sidebar scales with the window width (clamped to a sensible range) instead of staying a fixed 300px.
The Qt Quick UI is now the only interface; the old QtWidgets fallback and its build option were removed.
This also drops the now-unused Qt SVG-Widgets dependency from the build.
Fixed the connection status parsing: the server and IP shown during an active session now come from the connect command instead of a status field that does not exist.
Signing out no longer leaves the interface stuck showing an active connection.
Failed city/server list fetches no longer leave the loading spinner running forever.
Notifications are suppressed the first time the tray app starts.

description.p: Complete overhaul: new Qt Quick interface on a rewritten, tested core.

ul.li: Brand-new interface following Proton's visual language: persistent searchable server list with favorites and recents, connection status card, dark and light themes with live system-theme following.

Rewritten core: all CLI interaction now flows through a tested library with typed parsers, a connection state machine with a stuck-transition watchdog, and fast status polling during connect/disconnect.
Port forwarding now works inside the Flatpak sandbox.
New D-Bus control interface (Connect/Disconnect/Raise); launching a second instance now raises the existing window.
Quitting with an active connection no longer freezes the interface.
Crisp icons and flags on HiDPI displays.
